#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

/* @generated */
struct point {
    int x;
    int y;
};

/* @generated NOT */
int point_sum(struct point p)
{
    /* the user prefers a guard */
    if (p.x < 0) { return 0; }
    return p.x + p.y;
}

/* @generated */
int point_product(struct point p)
{
    return p.x * p.y;
}
